JSON.title: JSON
JSON.description: List of items in raw JSON format stored in one JSON file. Use this to export both data and annotations. This is a common Label Studio format.

JSON_MIN.title: JSON-MIN
JSON_MIN.description: List of items from raw JSON including only "from_name" and "to_name" values. Use this when exporting annotations only.

CSV.title: CSV
CSV.description: Results are saved in comma-separated format, with column names based on "from_name" and "to_name" values.

TSV.title: TSV
TSV.description: Results are saved in tab-separated table format, with column names based on "from_name" and "to_name" values.

COCO.title: COCO
COCO.description: A common machine-learning format used by COCO datasets. Supports object detection and image segmentation with polygons and rectangles.

YOLO.title: YOLO
YOLO.description: A common format that generates a TXT file per image. Each file contains class, coordinates, height, and width annotations for the corresponding image.

YOLO_OBB.title: YOLOv8 OBB
YOLO_OBB.description: A common format that generates a TXT file per image. Each file contains annotations for the corresponding image. YOLO OBB uses 4 corner coordinates (normalized 0–1) to represent bounding boxes, so rotated objects can be exported.

YOLO_OBB_WITH_IMAGES.title: YOLOv8 OBB with images
YOLO_OBB_WITH_IMAGES.description: YOLOv8 OBB format with downloaded images.

CONLL2003.title: CONLL2003
CONLL2003.description: A common format used in the CoNLL-2003 named entity recognition challenge.

VOC.title: Pascal VOC XML
VOC.description: A common XML format used for object detection and polygon image segmentation.

BRUSH_TO_NUMPY.title: Brush labels to NumPy
BRUSH_TO_NUMPY.description: Exports brush labels as NumPy 2D arrays. Each label is saved as one image.

BRUSH_TO_PNG.title: Brush labels to PNG
BRUSH_TO_PNG.description: Exports brush labels as PNG images. Each label is saved as one image.

ASR_MANIFEST.title: ASR manifest
ASR_MANIFEST.description: Exports speech-recognition transcription labels in the JSON manifest format expected by NVIDIA NeMo models.

BRUSH_TO_COCO.title: Brush labels to COCO
BRUSH_TO_COCO.description: Exports brush labels to COCO format for segmentation. Converts RLE-encoded masks to COCO polygons.
